REGULAR MEETING OF THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS
  ORANGE COUNTY, CALIFORNIA

  Tuesday, June 4, 2024,9 : 0 0 A . M .

  BOARD HEARING ROOM, FIRST FLOOR
  400 W. Civic Center Drive
  Santa Ana, California

  DONALD P. WAGNER
  CHAIRMAN
  Third District

 DOUG CHAFFEE  ANDREW DO
 VICE CHAIRMAN  SUPERVISOR
 Fourth District  First District

 VICENTE SARMIENTO  KATRINA
 SUPERVISOR  FOLEY
 Second District  SUPERVISOR
  Fifth District
ATTENDANCE:All Present

EXCUSED:None

 PRESENT:  COUNTY EXECUTIVE OFFICER  Frank Kim
  COUNTY COUNSEL  Leon J. Page
  CLERK OF THE BOARD  Robin Stieler

INVOCATION:Vice Chairman Chaffee, Fourth District, gave the invocation

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:Supervisor Foley, Fifth District invited Stephanie Lopez, Explorer with
the Orange
County Sheriff’s Department to sing the National Anthem and Supervisor Foley, led the assembly in the
Pledge of Allegiance

I.PRESENTATIONS/INTRODUCTIONS

 Chairman Wagner recognized awards received from the Association of California Cities - Orange
 County during their Golden Hub of Innovation Awards

 Chairman Wagner presented a resolution proclaiming May 2024 as "Foster Care Month"

 Chairman Wagner presented a resolution proclaiming June 15, 2024 as "World Elder Abuse Awareness
 Day"

II.CONSENT CALENDAR (Items 1-9)
 15243  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED WITH THE EXCEPTION OF ITEM 1 WHICH
  WAS DELETED

BOARD APPOINTMENTS
